conf.description: Tanium client-status, LEEF: split header + KVP the attribute body into tanium_fields, map client-health columns to ECS/custom, tag event.dataset.

conf.comment: Tanium client-status / syslog-leef: Connect emits a LEEF header followed by tab-delimited key=value attributes. Split the header with regex_extract, then serde-KVP into tanium_fields, map HostName/ComputerId/Status/RegisteredWithTLS (named in the format's enable text) to host.hostname/host.id/custom status/custom boolean, set _time from LastRegistration with a fallback, tag event.dataset. ValidKey (0/1, named only in recommendation prose) is mapped best-effort as a custom boolean. The Tanium Client version column name is not attested anywhere in this work order, so it is NOT mapped -- documented gap, per the brief's instruction to keep it out of agent.version anyway. LastRegistration is timezone-less per the source notes and parsed as-is (approximation, no deployment TZ offset available). Direct route, no guard hop.

functions.description: split the LEEF header (LEEF:ver|Tanium|product|ver|event id|) from the tab-delimited attribute body
extract the tab/space-delimited key=value attributes into a nested tanium_fields object
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
